run_KBCEngine_episode: run the KBCEngine episode method to train and evaluate a knowledge base completion model across epochs
create_KBCEngine: create a KBCEngine instance with an options dict to initialize dataset, model, optimizer, loss, and regularizer
setup_model: build a knowledge graph embedding model like TransE, ComplEx, TuckER, RESCAL, or CP from an options dict
setup_loss: create a loss function like BCEWithLogitsLoss or CrossEntropyLoss based on the world setting in options
setup_regularizer: build a regularizer like F2 or N3 with a given lambda value from an options dict
